summary: Make numerical target solving visible, including residuals and non-convergence.
objective: Let me drag a target for a planar arm and inspect each numerical IK iteration and its endpoint error.
example_prompts: Let me drag a target for a planar arm and inspect each numerical IK iteration and its endpoint error.
Show failure honestly when the target cannot be reached within the iteration budget.

entities.name: Planar arm
entities.guidance: Build base and rigid links with visible revolute pivots constrained to one plane.

entities.name: Target and residual
entities.guidance: Use a target ring distinct from the actual endpoint; join them with an error segment.

entities.name: Iteration trail
entities.guidance: Show a bounded history of endpoint candidates with iteration indices.

object_craft.structure: Build base and rigid links with visible revolute pivots constrained to one plane.
object_craft.material: Matte links and dark axis cylinders.

object_craft.structure: Use a target ring distinct from the actual endpoint; join them with an error segment.
object_craft.material: Contrasting target outline and solid actual endpoint marker.

object_craft.structure: Show a bounded history of endpoint candidates with iteration indices.
object_craft.material: Fading small dots, never a decorative trajectory claim.

state_contract.model: Declared forward map f(q), Jacobian J(q), target x*, initial guess, iteration count and residual norm; numerical update uses a documented pseudoinverse method with step bound and stopping tolerance.
state_contract.authority: Domain state owns identities, values and accepted transitions. Derive labels and meshes from that state; camera and display offsets are separate.
actions: Move target while solver is paused.
Step an iteration or solve to budget.
Reset initial guess and compare convergence.

invariants: Success requires computed residual below the declared tolerance and valid joint bounds.
Budget exhaustion or invalid numeric state reports failure without snapping tool to target.
The target marker is never used as the rendered tool position.
motion_guidance: Display discrete candidates; interpolation between candidates is presentation and not a collision-free trajectory.
Stop at the iteration budget and retain the last valid joint vector and residual.
known_limits: Local numerical method; convergence depends on initial guess and singularities.
Non-convergence alone is not proof of global unreachability; no torque or motion-planning guarantee.
Authored recipe only; runtime and rendered geometry checks have not run.

claims.statement: Numerical inverse kinematics can iteratively update joint values using a Jacobian pseudoinverse and endpoint error; initial guess and singularities affect convergence.
claims.scope: Local Newton-Raphson-style coordinate formulation; no guarantee of a globally reachable solution or collision-free motion.

source_refs.locator: Transcript paragraphs on initial guess, Jacobian pseudoinverse and stopping on endpoint error

physical_contract.scope: Numerical pose solving, not physical robot dynamics.
colliders: Link envelopes may flag candidate interference but do not certify trajectory clearance.
physical_contract.timestep: Use a declared fixed update step for changing model state; interpolate presentation only. Pause clears accumulated playback time.
checks: Unreachable target retains nonzero residual and honest failure; endpoint always derives from f(q).
